errors.evidence: The figure contains two connected pie charts, but the description refers to it as a single pie chart ("此饼图").

errors.text_span: 其中包含三个切片，总共有三个类别
errors.evidence: The figure contains two pie charts, each with two slices, for a total of four slices. The description incorrectly states there are three.

The label for the yellow slice (96.71%) is ““的”字只现不隐” (The character '的' only appears, is not hidden). The description misreads it as ““的”字只隐现” (The character '的' is only hidden/appears), which is ambiguous and closer in meaning to the label of the other slice in that chart.
The description incorrectly uses the word "时长" (duration) to describe a percentage value.

errors.text_span: 两个较小的切片是橙色，第一个...占比为 73.93%
errors.evidence: The slice representing 73.93% is blue, not orange. Additionally, it is the largest slice in its chart, not a smaller one.

errors.text_span: 第一个标记为“的”字只隐现+单音名词或者同音词
errors.evidence: This label is completely fabricated. The actual label for the 73.93% slice is “双音形容词+单音名词” (Disyllabic adjective + monosyllabic noun).

errors.text_span: 第二个标记为“单音形容词平音名词”
errors.evidence: The description hallucinates the character “平” in the label. The correct label for the 26.07% slice is “单音形容词+单音名词” (Monosyllabic adjective + monosyllabic noun).

errors.text_span: 并且“的”字缩短的切片被视觉上偏移
errors.evidence: No slice in either pie chart is visually offset, exploded, or emphasized in this way. The description hallucinates this visual feature.
The description fails to state the specific purpose of the chart as given in its title, “组合式“a的n”结构” (Combinatorial 'a de n' structure).

The description completely omits two of the four slices shown in the figure: the blue slice (“双音形容词+单音名词”, 73.93%) from the left chart, and the green slice (““的”字只隐不现”, 3.29%) from the right chart. It only partially describes the orange and yellow slices.
